annotations.variable_note: The Airport and Airway Extension Act of 2023, Part II, provided $1,464 million in contract authority (a form of mandatory budget authority) for the Airport Improvement Program through March 8, 2024. In keeping with the Balanced Budget and Emergency Deficit Control Act of 1985, CBO assumes that funding provided by that law will continue at the same rate through the rest of 2024 and in each subsequent year, resulting in an annual amount of $3,350 million.
